reason: Primary purpose is to provide a WeChat channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness, where WeChat messages are bridged into DSH agent sessions and responses are dispatched back to WeChat, including approval and question interactions; this is evidenced by the README’s WeChat bridge/DSH runtime description and the repo structure (`src/wechat`, `src/bridge`, `src/dsh`, `bin/login`). The plugin’s manifest and docs show it is intended as an integration plugin with external messaging infrastructure and local state handling, matching a medium-risk external service integration profile.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的微信接入插件，用于把 DSH 会话连接到 WeChat，实现扫码登录后的消息收发，并支持在微信内完成授权与提问交互。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness WeChat adapter that connects DSH agent sessions to WeChat, enabling QR-login based message exchange and approval/question interaction through the same runtime.

reasons.code: The plugin is documented as a WeChat access integration that relays DSH sessions to the ilink WeChat bot gateway, including a configurable backend URL and QR-code login flow, so it communicates with an external messaging service.
It persists runtime state under configurable directories (for example DSH_WECHAT_STATE_DIR / ~/.dsh-plugin-wechat), which implies local token/state/log directory usage and filesystem writes.

It documents user approval and ask-user flows through WeChat message round-trips, with actions continuing after reply, so it handles interactive remote control-style messaging between user and agent tooling.
